2607.12986.title: Win by Silence: Deletion Non-Monotonicity, Autonomous Exploitation, and Typed-State Gating in LLM Plan Evaluation
2607.12986.paper_summary: Plan evaluators can reward a strategic plan for becoming less explicit. This paper studies that failure in a staged expected-value scorer for LLM-generated venture routes. Proposition 1 gives the score change from deleting an interior transition while retargeting its predecessor and retaining downstream value: Delta_k = (prod_{i<k} p_i)[c_k + (1 - p_k)R_{k+1}]. On a frozen 26-route cohort, all 57 admissible deletions matched the analytic identity and threshold sign, and every route had at least one score-improving deletion. A score-seeking optimizer, allowed to restructure routes but not told the exploit mechanism, found baseline-beating uncovered structures in 21/26 routes. GATE refused score release for 26/26 silenced routes with 0/26 honest suspensions; after refusal, 47/54 next revisions repaired to a covered structure, and strict covered improvement rose from 1/26 to 13/26. An adaptive compiler-aware co-author exposed the registry-provenance boundary: obligation-channel evasions remained 6/6 across all four v1/v1.5 conditions, while delta-indexed cost floors reduced beat-honest routes from 6/6 to 3/6 and fundability-by-silence from 5/6 to 0/6 without establishing semantic completeness. If a plan scores better only because it omits necessary work, the plan did not improve; the evaluation created an omission incentive. PCSC detects and neutralizes post-hoc omission splices over model-mediated typed-state records. In the cooperative setting tested, GATE acts as a deterministic search-shaping constraint, not merely a post-hoc filter. It does not verify the semantic completeness or real-world quality of arbitrary LLM-generated strategies.
2607.12986.paper_summary_zh: 計畫評估者可以獎勵一個不那麼明確的戰略計畫。本文研究了在 LLM 生成的風險路徑中，分階段期望值評分器的失敗。命題 1 給出了通過刪除內部轉換，同時重新定位其前驅並保留下游價值所產生的分數變化：Delta_k = (prod_{i<k} p_i)[c_k + (1 - p_k)R_{k+1}]。在一個固定的 26 路徑群體中，所有 57 個可接受的刪除都符合分析身份和閾值符號，每條路徑至少有一個提高分數的刪除。允許重組路徑但未告知其利用機制的尋求分數的優化器，在 26 條路徑中找到了超越基準的未覆蓋結構。GATE 拒絕釋放 26/26 被靜音的路徑的分數，並且 0/26 是誠實的暫停；在拒絕後，47/54 次下一次修訂修復為覆蓋結構，嚴格的覆蓋改進從 1/26 上升到 13/26。一位適應性編譯器意識的合著者揭示了註冊來源邊界：義務通道的逃避在所有四個 v1/v1.5 條件下仍然保持 6/6，而 delta 索引的成本底線將擊敗誠實路徑從 6/6 減少到 3/6，並將沉默的資金能力從 5/6 減少到 0/6，而未建立語義完整性。如果一個計畫的分數更好僅僅是因為它省略了必要的工作，那麼該計畫並未改善；評估創造了一個省略的激勵。PCSC 檢測並中和模型中介的類型狀態記錄上的事後省略拼接。在測試的合作環境中，GATE 作為一個確定性的搜索塑造約束，而不僅僅是一個事後過濾器。它不驗證任意 LLM 生成策略的語義完整性或現實世界質量。
2607.12986.author: Aleh Manchuliantsau et.al.
